learningMaterial.title: A Quick Guide to the Quiz Concepts
learningMaterial.summary: Review addition, even numbers, and capital cities before trying the example quiz.

sections.title: Addition combines quantities
paragraphs: Addition finds the total after quantities are combined. For example, two objects plus two more objects produce four objects.

sections.title: Even numbers divide into equal pairs
paragraphs: An even integer is divisible by two with no remainder. Two and four are even, while three is odd.

items.label: Odd
items.detail: 3 leaves a remainder after division by two.

questions.explanation: Even numbers divide evenly by two.

questions.prompt: What is the capital of France?
questions.explanation: Paris is the capital and largest city of France.
